probe.text_sample: Adaline | Ship Agents That Self-Improve Docs Blog Get Started The Self-Improving Agent Never stop learning Adaline helps AI teams improve their agents autonomously, so you can find fires before they happen, ship fixes in minutes, and feel confidence in their agents — for the first time. Get Started Read Docs Trusted by Truly understand your agents Adaline ingests production traces and groups recurring agent patterns into behavior maps your team can inspect. Evals that write themselves Adaline generates evals from detected behaviors and user feedback, so regressions are caught before agent changes ship. From edge cases to test data Adaline generates production-faithful synthetic data for the scenarios you keep meaning to cover and the ones you never knew existed. Agents auto-improve while you sleep Adaline is the ML layer between your traces and your agent diffs — behaviors, evals, data. Cursor and Claude are the “make no mistake” guesses; this is the feedback loop grounded in real signals. “ Adaline has become an invaluable tool for my team to develop GenAI products... ” Tan S.
